thread_text:
emma: Spot check on pegasus-lite-int8 canary: seeing ~2.4% funcall parse errors. Parser fails on trailing-comma syntax, e.g. '{"name":"do", "arguments": {"x":1,}, }'.
marcus: that's a trailing-comma issue. Is the runtime inserting commas or is tokenizer emitting an extra comma token at chunk boundary?
yuki: looks like streaming chunks can end with a comma token and next chunk starts with a closing brace; combined it's a trailing comma. raw bytes for one failing trace: chunk1='...1,' chunk2=' }'
emma: immediate mitigation: conservative repair that strips a comma immediately before '}' or ']' when it appears at chunk boundary. will emit metric funcall.parse.repaired and include original bytes in debug-samples.
marcus: agree for canary only. don't hide regressing model behavior. add cap 1% and mark repaired=true.
ci-bot: CI: canary/pegasus-lite-int8 parse-smoke exceeded threshold; auto-rollback triggered.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pegasus-lite-int8 rolled back at 1765432120.
emma: next steps: tokenizer diff between int8 mapping and baseline q4, add onboarding gate to reject token maps that place comma as standalone token before closures, add unit tests replaying chunk boundaries.
marcus: I'll open comparator job and add streaming unit tests. yuki: I'll draft the repair PR for canary pool with metrics and debug-sample logging.
ci-bot: PR emma/pegasus-trailcomma-repair 5 unit_stream_chunked (PASS) on retry-1.
notes: pegasus-lite-int8 canary emitted comma tokens that led to trailing commas across chunk boundaries. quick canary-only repair + telemetry, tokenizer diff and onboarding gate planned
